status: A4 contract v2, revised for root's review of 3d01352. No runtime code reads it yet. scripts/art/check_viewmodel_framing.py checks the framing as pinhole math on socket points; that is not visual acceptance, and paw-mesh pixels and near-plane geometry need real captures. See docs/art-direction/FIRST_PERSON_VIEWMODEL_CONTRACT.md
scope: First person only. USoraViewmodelComponent also serves world-visible opponents and practice participants; their Build() and KernelPose() transforms stay exactly as today, independent of this contract.
frame: Eye space of ASoraCharacterBase::Eye (the WeaponRoot parent): X forward, Y right, Z up, centimetres; rotations are FRotator degrees [pitch, yaw, roll]. anchor_cm is where the pose's anchor socket sits; the mesh hangs from that socket.

camera.fov_axis: horizontal FOV at the nominal 16:9 aspect; MaintainYFOV and effective view rectangles are not modelled

socket_frame: Weapon sockets are in Blender metres of the weapon mesh: +X the line of action, +Z up, +Y the wielder's left (UE's FBX import flips Y). Grip_R is the right paw's hold, Grip_L the left paw's, Muzzle the business end. Build records store socket translations only; a socket whose axes the builder rotates is listed in that weapon's socket_axes with the builder call it comes from. All other sockets use the builder default axes x=(1,0,0), z=(0,0,1).
composition: Qpresentation = Qaim_presentation * Qaction_eye * Qrest, rightmost applied first, all about the WeaponRoot origin (the anchor). Bob and windup lift translate the WeaponRoot in eye coordinates. Only the presentation rest and state blend (blend_per_s); live gameplay aim - BowAimOffset, the shot direction and the HUD ray - is never delayed or changed.

motion.note: Today's magnitudes in USoraViewmodelComponent, unchanged, composed as above about each weapon's rest instead of the fixed (40,18,-18).
motion.bow_drawing: The bow.drawn pose replaces the legacy -15 degree drawing pitch (SoraPlayerCharacter::TickPlay). Never stack them: stacked, the drawn arrow line misses the reticle at 20 m by about 0.65 half-heights.

aim_presentation.note: BowAimOffset rotates the gameplay ray in the world camera (94 degrees). The same angle on the 70-degree first-person camera lands about 1.5 times further from the centre. The presentation-only correction points the drawn arrow line at the screen point where the HUD ray lands: direction (1, u * tan(fp/2), v * tan(fp/2) / aspect) for that point (u, v). The gameplay ray is unchanged.

envelopes.note: Every pose is checked at rest, in the two bob extremes, and in each of its own actions. At rest and in the bob: its visible sockets stay inside their screen boxes, partial ones in the edge band, and the clear line keeps off the reticle. In an action the blade may cross the reticle and a partial paw may leave the frame, but every socket stays in front of the near plane and every visible socket stays in the action band. A pose's motion_overrides replace a state's values for that pose only (presentation; gameplay unchanged).

hero_gear.rule: One idempotent reconciliation from the campaign grant (SoraBeatRules::EquipmentAllows: the task's equipment mask, or EquipmentRecovered), the held WeaponId and AmmoByWeapon[18]. It runs at beat start and checkpoint restart, chapter select, recovery completion, weapon change and ammo change; it creates each missing item component and destroys each absent one. Nothing is toggled hidden. No held item is also shown slung or sheathed.
